_: The five findings of the red (Screening) hero, in the EXACT keys lot S1 declared (message of the night of 5 to 6). Provenance: every figure in a/b/cote is a cell of ~/Documents/cascade-screening/releve-public.json at seal `sceau`; S1 refuses to build if the record on disk no longer matches that seal, and this file names each figure's cell in `source` beside it: {table, palier, seuil, mesure} reads releve[table].tables[palier][seuil][mesure] ({succes, n, taux, bas, haut}); {table, compte} reads releve[table][compte]. `source` is provenance for reviewers and future guards; builders may ignore it. Intervals in legends are Wilson 95% from the same cells, en dash, never an em dash. The declared recall floor behind finding 03 is 0.95 on the measured rate: chosen, not measured, and said on the fiche. `annotations` are provisional fractions of the tray box (anchor x, anchor y, label x, label y, text): the sieve tower is not rendered yet; S1 passes them through.

findings.titre: Exact never alarms. It also never finds.
findings.phrase: Exact match after normalisation raises no false alert on our written pairs, and that safety is the trap: it misses four true hits in five that your reviewers already confirmed.
findings.leg_a: recall on the 60 written match pairs, interval [13–34]: any threshold, exact is flat
findings.leg_b: false alerts on the 60 written non-match pairs, interval [0–6]
annotations: the strict sieve: almost nothing passes
true hits stopped with the noise

findings.titre: Loose matching finds everyone. And everyone else.
findings.phrase: Drop the threshold and nothing escapes: every true hit is caught. So is most of everything unrelated, and every false alert is analyst time you pay for.
findings.leg_a: recall at the loosest threshold of the sweep, interval [94–100], 60 match pairs
findings.leg_b: false alerts at the same threshold, interval [74–92], 60 non-match pairs
annotations: the loose sieve: everything falls through
noise outnumbers hits six to one

findings.titre: The frontier lives in the middle.
findings.phrase: Hold the measured recall at 95 percent or better, a floor we declare rather than measure, and the sweep of every tier and threshold settles on one cell. Even there, three alerts in four are false.
findings.leg_a: recall of the retained cell, jaro‑winkler at 0.60, interval [89–99]
findings.leg_b: false alerts at that same cell, interval [63–84]: the price of the floor
annotations: the middle sieve holds the frontier

findings.titre: Synthetic is declared. And never merged.
findings.phrase: The same cell, two provenances. On fabricated variants the false-alert rate reads ten times friendlier than on written pairs: blended, the synthetic half would flatter the tool. It is measured apart, labelled synthetic, and stays apart.
findings.leg_a: false alerts at the frontier cell, measured on the 60 written pairs, interval [63–84]
findings.leg_b: the same cell on 360 fabricated variants, interval [5–11]: kept apart precisely because it flatters

findings.phrase: Every pair behind these findings is ours: written and declared, or fabricated and labelled. One command replays the whole sweep on your own alert history, on your machine. Nothing leaves it.
findings.leg_a: written pairs behind the measured half, declared nature by nature
findings.leg_b: fabricated variants behind the synthetic half, labelled and kept apart
annotations: our pairs end where your export begins
